app.tagline: Personalized learning adventures for every child.

login.brand_heading: Sign in to continue your AIVO journey.
login.brand_body: Your tutors, missions, and family insights — all in one place, tuned for how your learner thinks.
login.quote: AIVO adapts to how my daughter actually learns. The first platform that didn't make us feel like we were fighting it.
login.card_subtitle: Sign in with your AIVO email and password.

errors.invalid_role: That role isn't available for this account.
errors.missing_credentials: Enter your email and password to sign in.
errors.mfa_required: We need a verification code to finish signing you in. Please enter it on the next screen.
errors.mfa_session_expired: Your verification session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.wrong_surface: This account signs in on a different surface (district or admin). Use the correct portal.
errors.unsupported_role: Your account role isn't supported on this surface yet.
errors.login_failed: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.

notices.password_reset: Your password has been reset. Please sign in with your new password.

signup.promo_title: A warmer way to learn — for every child in the family.
signup.promo_subtitle: Set up learners in minutes. Adaptive AI tutors, sensory-friendly modes, and progress every parent can see.
signup.benefit_tutors: Adaptive AI tutors that meet every learner where they are.
signup.benefit_sensory: Sensory-friendly modes: Standard, Calm, High Contrast.
signup.benefit_progress: Progress every parent can see — IEP-aware and quietly honest.
signup.reassurance_title: Adults set up accounts, not children.
signup.reassurance_body: You'll add learners on the next step. AIVO never asks a child to create their own account, and COPPA / FERPA / SOC 2 protections apply to everything from day one.
signup.card_title: Tell us a little about you
signup.password_helper: At least 8 characters with a number and a symbol.

forgot.heading: Reset your password
forgot.error_invalid_email: Enter a valid email address so we can find your account.
forgot.sent_title: If that email is registered, a reset link is on the way.
forgot.sent_subtitle: For your security, we don't reveal whether an account exists. The link expires in 1 hour.
forgot.sent_body: Check spam or promotions if you don't see it after a minute. The link works once and then expires — request a new one if you need to start over.
forgot.form_title: Enter the email on your account
forgot.form_subtitle: We'll email you a secure link to set a new password.

reset.heading: Choose a new password

errors.missing_token: This reset link is missing its security token. Request a new link from the forgot-password page.
errors.weak_password: Your new password must be at least 12 characters long.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords don't match yet. Try entering them again.
errors.invalid_token: This reset link has expired or has already been used. Request a new link to continue.
errors.policy_violation: That password doesn't meet our policy. See the details below and try a stronger one.
errors.reset_failed: We couldn't reset your password. Please try again in a moment.
errors.mock_mode: Password reset is disabled in mock mode. Run with AUTH_MODE=custom and the identity service to test this flow.

reset.no_token_subtitle: The link in your email is missing its security token. Request a new one to continue.
reset.no_token_body: For your security, reset links expire after 1 hour and can only be used once.
reset.form_subtitle: Choose something memorable but hard to guess. We'll sign you out of every device once you're done.
reset.helper_too_short: Use at least 12 characters with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols.
reset.helper_default: Use at least 12 characters. We'll reject reused or weak passwords.

mfa.heading: Verify it's you
mfa.totp_subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code shown for AIVO Learning.
mfa.webauthn_subtitle: Your account is protected by a passkey. Passkey sign-in isn't supported on this surface yet — use a recovery code below.
mfa.email_subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to the email on file. It expires in 10 minutes.
mfa.recovery_hint: Lost access? Use one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on MFA — enter it in the field above.

errors.missing_code: Enter the verification code we sent to continue.
errors.invalid_code: That code doesn't match. Double-check and try again.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Your account is temporarily locked — please try again in a few minutes.
errors.resend_failed: We couldn't send a new code. Please try again.
errors.resend_exhausted: You've reached the resend limit. Please sign in again to get a fresh code.

notices.resent: A new code has been sent to your email.

add_learner.title: Add a learner
add_learner.description: Just the basics now — you can update everything later from learner settings.
add_learner.error_invalid_title: A few details still need fixing.
add_learner.error_invalid_description: At minimum we need a first name and a valid birth year. Scroll up to see which fields are required.
add_learner.section_about_description: The name AIVO will use and a few identity basics.
add_learner.section_school_description: Helps AIVO match grade-level pacing and reading materials.
add_learner.section_strengths_description: Anything you share here helps AIVO calibrate from day one. All optional.
add_learner.known_strengths_placeholder: Loves animals · great at puzzles · remembers song lyrics
add_learner.known_strengths_help: One per line, or separate with commas. Up to 20 entries.
add_learner.known_challenges_placeholder: Easily distracted by sound · reluctant to write

notifications.title: Notifications & approvals
notifications.description: Every notification here has a clear action. Approvals link straight into the workflow they unblock.
notifications.inbox_desc: Tap an item to mark it read. Unread items show a soft dot.
notifications.empty_body: You'll see updates here when activity occurs.
notifications.reassure_actionable_body: If a notification can't be acted on, we don't send it. Reduces noise.
notifications.reassure_learners_body: Only age-appropriate messages reach your learner — never approvals, billing, or admin items.
notifications.reassure_safety_body: If anything safety-related ever appears, it goes to the top of this list and pings you immediately.
notifications.prefs_desc: Choose which updates reach you on each channel.

privacy.title: Privacy & your data
privacy.description: See what AIVO stores, who processes it, and request export or deletion at any time.
privacy.link_consent_desc: Review and revoke account- and learner-level consents.
privacy.link_export_desc: Download a copy of your family's data.
privacy.link_delete_desc: Request deletion of an account, a learner, or just IEP files.
privacy.subprocessors_desc: Third parties AIVO uses to deliver the service.

privacy_delete.title: Delete data
privacy_delete.description: Request deletion of your account, a specific learner, or just an uploaded IEP. We preserve a small audit trail required for compliance.
privacy_delete.warning_body: Once approved, learner progress, lesson history, and IEP files are removed. We keep the minimum legally required audit records (when the request was made, that consent was withdrawn) so the deletion itself can be proven later.

privacy_export.title: Request a data export
privacy_export.description: You can request a portable copy of your family's data at any time. We notify you when it is ready to download.

billing.title: Family plan & billing
billing.description: Plan, payment, and invoice history for {name}.
billing.no_active_plan_body: Pick a plan below to get started.
billing.reassure_hidden_title: Billing stays out of learner view
billing.reassure_hidden_body: Your learner never sees plan, payment, or invoice surfaces. Even when they switch into your account, billing is hidden.
billing.reassure_cancel_body: Cancellation keeps your learning history intact and you'll keep access until the period ends.
billing.no_invoices_body: Invoices appear here after each billing period closes.

brain_clone.awakening_narration_gathering: Every adventure you just had is becoming part of you.
brain_clone.awakening_narration_convergence: Watch as your strengths come together.
brain_clone.awakening_narration_formation: This brain is uniquely yours — built from what you love and how you learn.
brain_clone.awakening_narration_memories: The moments you shone brightest are now part of your brain forever.
brain_clone.awakening_narration_reveal: This is your brain. It will grow with you.
brain_clone.awakening_narration_settling: Your brain is ready. Let's begin.
brain_clone.watch_description: Watch each step as AIVO assembles your child's personalized learning brain from their assessment and baseline adventure.
brain_clone.watch_already_approved: This brain has already been approved.
brain_clone.clone_aria: Cloning AIVO's learning model into {name}'s personal brain
brain_clone.clone_caption: Cloning AIVO's learning model into {name}'s personal brain…
brain_clone.clone_finalising: Almost ready — finalising the personalised brain
brain_clone.clone_privacy_pii: No personal data leaves this device unencrypted
brain_clone.building_template_caption: Selecting a baseline Brain template for {name}'s grade level and learning profile.
brain_clone.building_domains_caption: Mapping domain scores from the baseline assessment
brain_clone.building_accommodations_caption: Configuring personalized supports based on evidence
brain_clone.building_accommodations_none: No additional accommodations needed at this level.
brain_clone.building_activation_caption: Initializing {name}'s Brain — saving snapshot and activating the learning engine
brain_clone.building_tutors_caption: Calibrating each AI tutor to {name}'s levels
brain_clone.building_complete_caption: The Brain has been built from {name}'s assessment data. Review the details below and decide what happens next.

errors.title: Hmm — that didn't work
errors.body: Let's take a quick breath and try again.

notifications.description: Notes from your teacher and your grown-ups.

tutor.input_placeholder: Ask anything — I'll guide you, never spoil the answer.

homework.title: Stuck on something? Show me.
homework.body: Snap a photo or upload a file and I'll walk you through it step by step.
homework.input_placeholder: Type what you tried or ask a question…
homework.card_try: First, I'll ask you to try
homework.card_hint: Then I give you a small hint
homework.card_walkthrough: If you're still stuck, we walk through it

subjects.page_description: Each subject has a tutor and a recommended next step. Tap a card to dive in.
subjects.baseline_needed_body: Your subject pages light up after you complete a quick baseline check-in.

settings.title: Make AIVO yours
settings.description: Pick how AIVO looks, sounds, and speaks to you.
settings.language_desc: AIVO will use this language for buttons, menus, and helper messages. Your lessons stay in the subject's language.
settings.a11y_desc: Larger text, reduced motion, captions, and switch scanning.
settings.sound_desc: Pick the helper voice AIVO uses to read out questions and feedback.

settings_a11y.title: How you like to learn
settings_a11y.body: Tweak these any time — your lessons will follow along. Every option is built into the calm AIVO experience, never a separate mode.
settings_a11y.card_desc: Big text, dyslexia-friendly font, extra spacing, high contrast.
settings_a11y.reassure_wcag_body: Every AIVO screen meets WCAG 2.2 AA out of the box. These settings let you push further when you need to.
settings_a11y.reassure_labels_body: Turning on supports never marks your learner as different — the interface stays calm and premium.
settings_a11y.reassure_teachers_body: Whatever you turn on here is applied during lessons, homework, and the AI tutor — no extra setup.

settings_audio.no_learner_body: Sign in as a learner to view audio settings.
settings_audio.title: Read-aloud
settings_audio.description: Pick a voice and playback speed. Your grown-up controls whether read-aloud is turned on.
settings_audio.no_audio_support: Your browser does not support audio playback.
settings_audio.preview_unavailable: Audio preview unavailable — transcript fallback shown above.
settings_audio.preview_text: Hello! This is your read-aloud voice preview.

index.notready_title: A grown-up is still setting this up
index.notready_body: Ask the grown-up who signed you up — they have a couple of questions to finish before AIVO can plan your check-in.
index.ready_title: Hi {name} — ready to show me how you think?
index.ready_body: Three calm steps before the first question. Pick what you want to start with, AIVO does the rest.

why.eyebrow: How AIVO got ready for you
why.title: Hi {name} — I made this for you.
why.body: A grown-up answered a few questions so I'd know how you like to learn. If they shared an IEP, I read the supports too. Here's what I'm doing right now:
why.card1_body: Every question is picked just for what your grown-up shared — not from a big shared quiz.
why.card2_body: This isn't a test. AIVO uses what you show to plan calm, just-right lessons.
why.card3_body: You can pause, take a breath, or stop for today. AIVO will remember where you were.

subjects.title: Where do you want to start?
subjects.body: Pick one or more subjects. AIVO will pick a small handful of friendly questions just for you.
subjects.error_pick_one: Pick at least one subject to start.
subjects.picked_note: Subjects with a "Picked by grown-up" tag come from your parent's setup.

readiness.title: Quick check before we start
readiness.body: Nothing here is a test. Just a few things AIVO turns on so the baseline feels just right.
readiness.readaloud_off: You can turn it on per question
readiness.readaloud_body: Tap the speaker on any question to hear the words. No one will know — promise.
readiness.calm_body: Soft colors and quiet motion so it's easier to focus. You can change this any time.
readiness.breaks_body: You can pause whenever. AIVO will remember and pick up where you left off.
readiness.extratime_body: There's no clock anyway. Take all the time you need.

intro.title: Ready, {name}?
intro.body_with_tutor: {tutorName} from the {landmark} is here to help you start. We'll go one question at a time. Skip anything you don't want to try.
intro.body_default: We'll go one question at a time. Skip anything you don't want to try.
intro.questions_note: Short and friendly. Skip anything if you'd rather move on.
intro.time_note: Pause whenever. AIVO will remember where you left off.

home.streak_value: {days, plural, =0 {Start today} one {# Day} other {# Days}}
home.setup_body_baseline: We need a quick baseline check so we can build a lesson plan just for you.
home.setup_body_wait: Just a moment — we're picking something special.
home.msg_hint_body: Tap the read-aloud speaker on any question to hear it. No grades — just exploring together.
home.msg_supports_body: Read-aloud, calm pacing, and {count, plural, one {# other support} other {# other supports}} from your IEP are active.
home.msg_break_body: Stretch, sip water, look out the window. AIVO will save your place.

welcome.brand_title: Learning that meets every child where they are.
welcome.brand_body: AIVO is a calm, accessible learning platform built with families, teachers, and learners — including children who learn differently.
welcome.title: Let's get started.
welcome.subtitle: Sign in to continue, or create a new account for your family, school, or district.
welcome.invite_lead: Have an invite code from a school or district?
welcome.body: AIVO works on the web, on tablets, and on phones. You can switch between devices anytime — your progress comes with you.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.subtitle: Use the email you set up with your family, school, or district.
signin.reassure_body: Your email is used only to identify your account. Read the privacy notice for more.

signup.title_default: Tell us a little about you
signup.subtitle_invite: Paste the code from your school or district invitation. You can finish setting up your role next.
signup.subtitle_default: We'll personalize the next steps based on who you are setting up AIVO for.
signup.reassure_title: Adults set up accounts, not children.
signup.reassure_body: If you are creating an account for a child, you'll add them on the next step. AIVO never asks a child to create their own account.
signup.invite_helper: Your school or district sent this in the welcome email.
signup.password_helper: At least 12 characters. We'll check it isn't in any known leak before saving it.

role.title: Who are you setting up AIVO for?
role.subtitle: We'll customize the next steps. You can add other roles later — many adults are both a parent and a teacher.
role.reassure_body: A parent or teacher adds a learner. The learner sees a kid-friendly view with their schoolwork — never this page.
role.parent_desc: Set up AIVO for one or more children at home.
role.teacher_desc: Join a school that already uses AIVO, or start a class.
role.school_admin_desc: Manage staff, classes, and compliance for a school.
role.district_admin_desc: Oversee multiple schools, billing, and reporting.

parent_setup.title: Tell us about your household.
parent_setup.subtitle: You'll add your children on the next step. This information helps us route invitations and share progress with the right grown-ups.
parent_setup.reassure_body: We never sell household information. Co-parents only see learners they are added to.
parent_setup.household_helper: Shown to teachers when they message you. You can change it later.
parent_setup.coparent_helper: They'll get an email with their own sign-in. You can both approve consents and view progress.

learner_new.title: Tell us about your child.
learner_new.subtitle: Use only what you'd say out loud — first name is fine. You can add more learners later from your home screen.
learner_new.reassure_body: No surname, no date of birth, no address required here. You'll see exactly what teachers and AI use on the consent step.
learner_new.grade_band_help: We use a band, not a birthday. You can change it any time.
learner_new.iep_legend: Does your child have an IEP or 504 plan?
learner_new.iep_help: You can upload it on the next steps — only with your explicit consent. Skip if you'd rather decide later.

consent.title: Choose what AIVO can do.
consent.subtitle: Each row is a separate choice. You can change any of these later from Settings → Privacy.
consent.reassure_body: School data sharing and AI personalization are independent. You can say yes to one and no to the other.
consent.footer_note: You'll be asked to re-confirm any choice that affects your child later — never silently changed.
consent.row_parent_desc: I confirm I am the parent or legal guardian for the learners on this account, and I agree to AIVO's Terms.
consent.row_school_title: Share progress with my child's school
consent.row_school_desc: Lets your child's teachers see mastery, lessons, and IEP supports. Independent from any AI choice below.
consent.row_ai_desc: AIVO uses your child's responses to adjust pacing, examples, and hints. We never sell this data. Turning this off keeps your child in non-personalized lessons.
consent.row_mkt_desc: A short monthly email. Never sent to learners.
consent.legal_summary: What each choice actually changes (plain English).
consent.legal_parent_body: required to create accounts for anyone under 18. Verifies you are the legal guardian.
consent.legal_school_body: teachers see mastery, lessons, and (if uploaded) IEP supports. No marketing or third-party sharing.
consent.legal_ai_body: AIVO adapts pacing and hints to your child. Training data is never used to identify an individual learner.
consent.legal_mkt_body: a low-volume email list. Unsubscribe in one click.

permissions.title: What may AIVO use on this device?
permissions.subtitle: These are the only device features AIVO ever asks for. We never request location, contacts, or photo library access.
permissions.reassure_title: Your browser asks for these too.
permissions.reassure_body: When AIVO actually needs the microphone or camera, your browser will pop its own permission prompt — you can deny it even if you said yes here.
permissions.mic_desc: Used only for speak-to-read lessons and AI tutor voice mode. Off by default — turn on if your child wants to read aloud.
permissions.cam_desc: Used only when scanning a homework page or document. AIVO never records video.
permissions.notifs_desc: Approval requests, weekly progress digests, and safety messages. Lesson reminders are off by default — you can enable them later.

pin.title: Pick a 4-digit PIN for your child.
pin.subtitle: Your child uses this PIN to unlock their learning on this device. The PIN never replaces your parent sign-in.
pin.reassure_title: A PIN is a soft lock, not a vault.
pin.reassure_body: It keeps a sibling from opening the wrong profile. Sensitive actions still require a parent sign-in.
pin.skip: Skip — set a PIN later from Settings

parent_verify.subtitle_phone: We'll text a one-time code to confirm you're the adult on this account. We never use this number for marketing.
parent_verify.subtitle_code: We sent a code to your phone. It expires in 10 minutes.
parent_verify.reassure_body: A child profile becomes active only after a parent has verified. This is how AIVO enforces parental approval.
parent_verify.phone_helper: We use this only for verification and account recovery.

privacy.title: What AIVO does — in plain English.
privacy.subtitle: Below is the short version. Each section opens to the full legal text. You can re-read this any time from Settings.
privacy.reassure_body: We never sell student data. Not to advertisers, not to vendors, not to AI training partners.
privacy.collect_summary: What we collect — only what's needed to teach.
privacy.collect_learner: Learner: first name or nickname, grade band, optional accommodations (IEP / 504), responses to lessons.
privacy.collect_device: Device: browser, OS, app version — for debugging only.
privacy.ai_body: When AI personalization is on, your child's responses adjust their next lesson — pacing, examples, hints. We do not use these responses to identify your child. We do not train foundation models on identifiable student work. Model providers are bound by contract to delete prompt and completion data within 30 days.
privacy.who_you: You and any co-parent you added: full progress.
privacy.who_teachers: Teachers at the school you opted in to: lesson mastery and IEP supports for their classes only.
privacy.who_staff: AIVO staff: encrypted access for support, with audit logs. We never browse student work casually.
privacy.rights_summary: Your rights and how to delete.
privacy.rights_body: You can export every record AIVO holds about your account or your child from Settings → Privacy → Export. You can delete the account the same way. Deletion is permanent within 30 days; you can cancel during the grace period.

terms.title: AIVO Terms of Use.
terms.subtitle: Summary first. Tap any section for the full legal text. Last updated: this page is a placeholder for the final legal-reviewed copy.
terms.agree_body: You agree to use AIVO for the purpose of educating yourself, your child, or your students. You won't try to bypass safety filters, re-sell access, or use AIVO output to train competing models.
terms.aivo_body: We will keep your data private as described in our privacy notice, give you 30 days' notice of any material change to these terms, and let you export everything we hold at any time.
terms.children_body: For accounts that include learners under 13, a verified parent or guardian must consent. We do not knowingly create child-controlled accounts. Schools acting in loco parentis must have a signed data processing agreement on file.
terms.wrong_body: Either of us can end this agreement. Your data export remains available for 90 days after closure. Disputes are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in your billing address.

recovery.title: Trouble signing in? We'll send a link.
recovery.subtitle: Enter the email on your AIVO account. We'll email a one-time link that lets you reset your password.
recovery.reassure_title: We don't say whether the email exists.
recovery.reassure_body: Either way, we'll show the same confirmation. This stops bad actors from learning which addresses have accounts.

child_approval.title: Approve your child's access.
child_approval.subtitle: These are the experiences your child can use on AIVO. You can change any of these from their profile later.
child_approval.reassure_title: Your child is waiting on you.
child_approval.reassure_body: Until you press Approve, this profile is in a holding state. Your child cannot sign in or start lessons.
child_approval.footer_note: You'll arrive on the parent home with your child set up and ready.
child_approval.comm_desc: Your child can read messages from teachers and reply with adult-moderated quick responses.
child_approval.ai_desc: A conversational tutor that explains concepts, never produces final answers, and routes safety topics to an adult.
child_approval.voice_desc: Lets your child speak to the tutor and listen back. Off by default — uses the microphone.

iep_upload.title: Add your child's plan — only if you want to.
iep_upload.subtitle: If you have an IEP or 504, AIVO can extract accommodations (extra time, read-aloud, etc.) so lessons match it from day one. You can do this later, or never.
iep_upload.reassure_body: Only you, any co-parent, and teachers at the schools you've opted in to will see it. AI extraction runs in-tenant. The original file is encrypted at rest.
iep_upload.footer_note: You can upload later from your learner's profile.
iep_upload.consent_title: I explicitly consent to upload an IEP / 504 plan
iep_upload.consent_desc: AIVO will store the document, extract listed accommodations, and apply them to lessons. You can delete it any time.
iep_upload.choose_file: Choose a PDF or Word file
iep_upload.file_help: Files up to 20 MB. We'll show a preview of what we extracted before applying anything.
iep_upload.legal_summary: What gets extracted, and what doesn't.
iep_upload.legal_extracted_body: accommodation list (extra time, read aloud, breaks), goal categories, support service hours.
iep_upload.legal_never_body: medical diagnoses, psychological evaluations, parent statements, signatures.
iep_upload.legal_teachers_body: only the accommodations list, only at schools you've opted in to.

invite_school.title: Join your school on AIVO.
invite_school.subtitle: Paste the code your school sent you. If you don't have one, ask your school admin — only invited staff can join.
invite_school.reassure_body: An admin must invite you. This protects rosters and student data.
invite_school.email_helper: Must match the email the admin invited.

invite_district.title: Join your district on AIVO.
invite_district.subtitle: District admin invites are issued by AIVO during onboarding. Your district success manager will send you a one-time code.
invite_district.reassure_body: Every sign-in for this role requires a fresh biometric or PIN check. AIVO never lets a single password unlock district data.

error.expired_invite_subtitle: Invites expire after 30 days. Ask the person who sent it to issue a new one.
error.expired_invite_body: If your school or district sent this, contact your admin. AIVO support can also re-send if you provide the original code.
error.expired_invite_reassure_body: Your seat at the school or district is still reserved — only the link expired.
error.offline_title: We can't reach AIVO right now.
error.offline_subtitle: Check your connection and try again.
error.offline_body: Some learner activities work offline once a lesson has loaded — but setup needs a live connection.
error.offline_reassure_body: We'll pick up exactly where you left off as soon as you're back online.
error.blocked_subtitle: AIVO support has paused this account. This is usually a billing or compliance review.
error.blocked_body: You'll get an email at the address on file once the review finishes, usually within one business day.
error.blocked_reassure_body: We don't delete anything during a review — pause and resume only.
error.generic_subtitle: It's probably temporary — try again in a moment.
error.generic_body: If this keeps happening, please contact AIVO support and mention what you were trying to do.
error.generic_reassure_title: Nothing was charged or saved incorrectly.
error.generic_reassure_body: AIVO never persists half-finished setup data.
